notes: Voxel Resonance - A first-person 3D puzzle-exploration game where players use a phase-shifting scanner to reveal hidden architecture across 4 dimensional frequencies. Core mechanics: spatial reasoning through phase-shifting (geometry exists in same 3D space at different phases), line-of-sight scanning with wave propagation visualization, momentum-based movement with step-up, crouching, sprinting. 5 authored levels with increasing complexity, procedural terrain, phased platforms/columns/bridges, collectible resonance crystals, exit portals. Procedural audio synthesis (Web Audio API) for all SFX and ambient music. Custom GLSL shaders for phase materials, crystal rendering, and scan wave effect. Quality presets (Low/Medium/High/Ultra/Auto), full keyboard/mouse + touch controls, save/load via localStorage, pause/menu/completion flows, WCAG AA contrast, reduced motion support, responsive UI. Runs from single index.html with Three.js via CDN.
